notes:
This leaf gives a diagram of exact rows with vertical maps and Galois identifications. It states that the kernel J of the map from the generic to the integral group maps isomorphically to inertia I_s-prime, canonically isomorphic to T. It then describes the section induced by the rational point, its inertia map into pi by a composition with mu times the identity, and the resulting image in the normalizer of L_i. The last D’ailleurs is an unfinished continuation. These are descriptions of what the page states, not verified mathematical results.
The whole image was viewed once and each full-resolution half once; every word, formula, deletion and insertion was compared with both witnesses. Eighteen distinct saved Pillow crops were inspected once after the overview. They use original boxes recorded in this report, autocontrast, LANCZOS resizing to 2200 pixels wide, and sharpening. No OCR, text recognition, other leaf, or external research was used. The first reader performed no mathematical proof or computation. The main reader checked only the formal kernel argument recorded below. The count is 16 prose rows plus five diagram object ranks, excluding the supralinear additions and marginal folio.
The header and most wording follow C. Both equals-sign short forms are resolved locally from two horizontal levels, with no m. The two Gal identifications use oblique simeq signs, not upright parallel bars: their curved members occupy opposite sides, retained by locally rotated TikZ signs. Completed adjudication reads the upper EU-to-E diagram link and the first three lower-row links as bare shafts. The prose kernel and composite links and the local map T-pi also retain bare shafts; the separately written prose map E_U-tildeK to E_tildeK retains its arrow. The hom.-lacet(s) reading is supported against both witnesses, including its separate point, hyphen, tall l and crossed t; the final s remains doubtful against a terminal return, so lacets|lacet is retained. The point description and group-decomposition phrase remain insertions in their observed positions. The three kappa/k forms remain explicitly ambiguous; neither alphabet is rejected, and C is placed first only for continuity. The cancelled subscript in the overwritten diagram node and the final cancelled parenthesis remain doubtful. The unchanged live I in the inertia sentence is retained even though the earlier kernel is corrected to J. No author question mark or new mathematical doubt is visible on this leaf. The diagram macro stands at text level without an external display-math wrapper; no compilation was run.

088N1 (targeted proof check, main reader): in a commutative diagram of short exact group rows 1→P→G→Q→1 and 1→P′→G′→Q′→1, with P→P′ an isomorphism, ker(G→G′)→ker(Q→Q′) is an isomorphism. Injectivity follows because an element in both ker(G→G′) and P must be trivial. For surjectivity, lift q in the lower-map kernel to g in G; its image in G′ lies in P′, so divide g by the unique corresponding element of P. This verifies the formal kernel identification used in the prose, conditional on the exact diagram as stated. It does not establish the geometric exactness or the final normalizer assertion. The collation compares the preferred reading when an explicit alternative remains: the three unresolved kappa/k places are recorded against H’s fixed Latin letter, without claiming that this alphabet choice is settled.

Blind adjudication restores K in the departure-group index, the point domain and its base after comparison with the small K forms on 086/090/093/096 and eta on 102. The local large K in K-rat. supports the notation, but the short foot rather than a long eta descender is the visible distinction. Four diagram connectors now remain headless: upper EU-to-E and the first three lower-row links. The cancellation after E_tilde K probably contains a parenthesized tilde f_K or j_K; s-prime remains a less likely alternative under the hatching. The accent in définie and terminal s of lacets remain explicitly doubtful. All sixteen token-different boxes were inspected.

check_events.outcome: Verified the formal kernel isomorphism for a commutative diagram of short exact group rows with an isomorphism on left kernels, by lifting and correcting a preimage. Exactness of the geometric rows and the final normalizer assertion were not proved.
